Name: grep_search
Description:
Search workspace files for literal text, or a regular expression when IsRegex is true.
Returns numbered matching lines with a line of context, grouped by file. Protected and ignored paths are skipped.

Query.description: The text, or a .NET regular expression with IsRegex.

SearchPath.description: Absolute path of the workspace file or directory to search.

Includes.description: Path wildcards limiting the files searched, such as *.ps1.

IsRegex.description: Treat Query as a regular expression (matched under a short timeout).

MatchPerLine.description: True (default) returns every matching line; false returns only the first match in each file.

Name: codebase_search
Description:
Find code related to a description or identifiers, ranked by relevance (BM25, plus embeddings when the USER enabled hybrid search).
Returns whole functions or bounded chunks with their locations. Use grep_search for exact text.

Query.description: Words or identifiers describing what you are looking for.

SearchPath.description: Optional absolute path of a workspace file or directory to search within.
